ValidationRule.description: Restricts the transitions from "In Progress" to only allow "Nurtured", "Referred", or "Closed Lost".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "In Progress"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurtured")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Referred")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status change. From "In Progress", you can only move the Lead to "Nurtured", "Referred", or "Closed Lost".
